name: Unleashed
label: Unleashed Software REST — products, orders, stock
description: api.unleashedsoftware.com. Official auth is api-auth-id + HMAC-SHA256 of the query string. OfficialApiNode sends api_id as header api-auth-id only — HMAC is not applied. Wholesale inventory. Never log customer PII.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: product_get | sales_order_get | purchase_order_get | stock_on_hand. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not an HTTP call.

schema.label: productGuid
schema.description: URL path parameter `productGuid` for operation: product_get. Required by: product_get.

schema.label: orderGuid
schema.description: URL path parameter `orderGuid` for operations: sales_order_get, purchase_order_get. Required by: sales_order_get, purchase_order_get.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: product_get | sales_order_get | purchase_order_get | stock_on_hand. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Api Id
configurationParameters.description: Unleashed API id. Header api-auth-id. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Customer owns the merchant account.

configurationParameters.label: Client Type
configurationParameters.description: Sent as the client-type header Unleashed requires on every request to identify the integration. Free text, lowercase, no spaces or special characters, ideally ~20 characters: <account_name>/<app_name> for in-house integrations or <partner_name>/<app_name> when outsourced. Example: yourcompany/studioquack.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.
